description: Connect your existing Go Rocket account before making a video. Call this to open the connector's OAuth sign-in. Say: 'Connect your Go Rocket account: sign in when this connector asks. If no sign-in opens, reconnect Go Rocket in your connector settings.' In Claude Code, open /mcp, select go-rocket, then Authenticate. Return to the same chat and retry create_video; existing credits work here.
name: sign_in
title: Connect your Go Rocket account
